posts.text: I'm thrilled to bring back my Summer Reading Challenge for another year! The challenge will help kids fall in love with reading outside the classroom and stave off summer learning loss. Prizes and friendly competition will add to the fun.

posts.text: Honoured to speak at Bitcoin 2026 alongside Acting AG Todd Blanche. We'll be discussing how federal policy is evolving around Bitcoin development, free speech, and the right to build great products in America. The future of digital assets and open-source rights matters.

posts.text: The AI policy landscape is evolving fast. As we shape frameworks for responsible AI development in the US, it's critical we maintain America's leadership while creating pathways for innovation. Great conversations happening in Washington this week.

posts.text: At the World Bank, our mission is clear: end extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity. We continue to drive investments in climate adaptation, digital infrastructure and human capital across the developing world. The urgency has never been greater.

posts.text: Ten years on from the Brexit referendum, we've got to look forward. A stronger, closer relationship with Europe is in the UK's best interest, particularly in a world that is as volatile as it is. We will introduce a dynamic alignment bill this session.

posts.text: France, the UK and Germany are proposing a partial 30-day truce for Ukraine — stopping the fighting in the air, on the seas and against energy infrastructure. Europe must speak with one voice. We have vital interests to defend, and Russia needs to hear that.
posts.caption: France, the UK and Germany are proposing a partial 30-day truce for Ukraine — stopping the fighting in the air, on the seas and against energy infrastructure. Europe must speak with one voice. We have vital interests to defend, and Russia needs to hear that.

posts.text: AI is the most profound platform shift of our lifetimes. It's lighting up every part of our business. Today we announced an ~$85 billion equity raise — the demand for our AI solutions is meaningfully exceeding our available supply. We're just getting started.

posts.text: There's a real platform shift. We're moving from building operating systems, devices for apps, to agents. At Build 2026, we unveiled Project Solara with Qualcomm, new Surface RTX Spark Dev Box, and the vision for unmetered intelligence on every desk.
